instruction:
You are tasked with creating a game using Verilog that utilizes a VGA display. The game will be controlled by four switches: up_switch, dn_switch, left_switch, and right_switch. The VGA display will output a 640x480 pixel image, and will have the following outputs:
- HS (horizontal sync)
- VS (vertical sync)
- RED (3-bit output)
- GREEN (3-bit output)
- BLUE (2-bit output)

The game will have a square object that moves around the screen based on the user's input from the switches. The object will be 30x30 pixels and will be located at a random starting position on the screen. The user will control the object's movement using the switches as follows:
- up_switch: move the object up by one pixel
- dn_switch: move the object down by one pixel
- left_switch: move the object left by one pixel
- right_switch: move the object right by one pixel

The game will also have a border around the screen that is 10 pixels wide. The border will be displayed in red (RGB value 111) and will not move. The object will be displayed in green (RGB value 111) and will move around the screen. The background of the screen will be displayed in blue (RGB value 011) and will not move.

Your task is to create a Verilog module that implements the game described above.
